summary.text: Josh Morris is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 91, representing Leeds, Turner, and Wayne.
The page lists Josh Morris as ranking member of the Elections committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Josh Morris's education as USM.
The page lists Josh Morris's occupation as Realtor.
Josh Morris lives in Turner and has served 4 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
